regions.model_scope: Dallas ISD independent 2024–25 published-rate grade-school district models: exact operational CCD LEA 4816230 / native TX-057905 / TAPR district 057905 attachments. All 189 native enrolled positive grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles remain searchable; 188 schools enter each separately fitted Math, ELA and Combined model using original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above displays and precise same-year individual economic-status enrollment ratios. The blank Alternative profile remains unmodeled. High, mixed, primary-only and nonoperational records remain outside this distinct point-only population. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
